claims.title: All exterior and simultaneous contraction ranks of canonical Full partial sums
claims.statement: For a canonical shared-first partial sum of c Full(a,b_i) blocks, N=sum b_i, every field and p>=0 give rank K_B^p = a binom(N,p+1) - max(a-p-1,0) binom(N-c,p+1). For q>=1 the simultaneous positionwise contraction has rank D_q = a N^q - max(a-q,0)(N-c)^q. The proofs identify the explicit evaluation kernel O(-1)^(N-c) on the projective line and its exterior or tensor powers.
dependencies: Explicit polynomial evaluation syzygies and fiberwise kernel proofs
Elementary global sections of line bundles on the projective line
claims.limitations: The source blocks share the same canonical first coefficient basis. Independent source first identifications are not included in this B-leg formula. The maps supply necessary rank conditions, not tensor constructions or exponent bounds.

claims.title: Every output-leg Koszul rank of a zero-free bilinear tensor is a universal format maximum
claims.statement: Over C, let a>=2, N>=1 and M>=N+a-1. If a tensor of format (a,N,M) has injective B*-to-C slice for every nonzero first covector, then every output-leg Koszul rank equals the explicit alternating-kernel formula, equivalently the positive padded-Full formula. These ranks depend only on (a,N,M) and are the largest attainable ranks among all tensors in that format. Every Full partial sum with arbitrary independent invertible first identifications satisfies the hypothesis. In particular every (5,100,140) target passes every C-leg Koszul comparison against 10 Full(5,10).
dependencies: BEKS13 tensor-complex machinery, with a separate self-contained symmetric/exterior quotient resolution here
Nonempty open zero-free locus and determinantal rank semicontinuity
claims.limitations: Complex field; a>=2 and the stated zero-free source hypothesis. This is one necessary rank family. It does not imply a degeneration, a general barrier for projected or other Young flattenings, independent review, or exponent improvement.
